prompt: What is the minimum value of the function $f(x) = x^2 - 8x + 12$?
hint: Find where the vertex is first, using $x = -\dfrac{b}{2a}$.

hints.text: Find where the vertex is first, using $x = -\dfrac{b}{2a}$.

learningObjective: Find the minimum of a quadratic given in standard form.
explanation: The parabola opens upward ($a = 1 > 0$), so it has a minimum at its vertex.

alternativeExplanations.title: Complete the square instead
steps: Now it is in vertex form and the vertex $(4, -4)$ is visible without computing anything.
Completing the square costs a few more seconds but produces the whole vertex, not just half of it.
